ff35-38.summary: The Senate tells its ambassador Giovanni Mocenigo that the French ambassador, setting out the troubles and needs of Henry III, asked Venice to help him (with the Emperor) against the imminent danger to the crown, and sends a copy of its answer. Read only in part: ff. 35v-36v are mostly unread because the digits are unresolved on the available images.

snip.cap: f. 35r: the ducal protocol in clear Latin, then the first lines of the Zifra Prima cipher

system: Council of Ten's Zifra Prima (1577-78): two-part nomenclator, base letters a c d f g h with figures 1-99 for single letters (homophones), syllables, words, numerals, doubled letters and nulls, mixed; this letter adds d83 = a and c86 = o.
